class.name: SteamNotificationSessionOperation
class.brief_description: Retained observation of one notification session.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Settles local observation with [constant ERR_SKIP]. An already submitted request can still reach Steam and commit its durable receipt. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if observation has ended.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether this observation has a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the terminal result, or [code]null[/code] while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Use [code]await operation.wait()[/code] to receive a [SteamNotificationSessionResult] before or after settlement.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once with the same terminal result available from [method result].
